params.name: start
params.description: The start date. Must be less than the end date.

params.name: end
params.description: The end date. Must be greater than the start date.

params.name: actingUserId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user that performed the event.

params.name: itemId
params.description: The unique identifier of the related item that the event describes.

params.name: continuationToken
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination.

items.docs:
Returns a filtered list of your organization's event logs, paged by a continuation token.
If no filters are provided, it will return the last 30 days of event for the organization.
